# Data Source: identitynow_transform

Use this data source to look up a transform by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_transform" "country_lookup" {
  name = "Country Lookup"
}
```

Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Transform ID. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Transform name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `attributes_json` (String) Transform attributes as a JSON object.
- `internal` (Boolean) Whether this is a SailPoint internal transform.
- `type` (String) Transform operation type.
